### Junior Software Developer

Irene, Centurion

Full-time

Drive.co.za is one of South Africa’s fastest-scaling technology start-ups, reshaping the automotive industry through data, software, and innovation. We’re looking for a Junior Software Developer, someone with a strong mathematical or analytical background who wants to build real systems and grow into a professional developer.

**Who we’re looking for**

- A recent graduate or final-year student with a degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Actuarial Science, or a similar analytical field.
- A passion for logic, systems, and problem-solving, even if you haven’t coded professionally yet.
- Curious, analytical, and eager to learn Java and Angular (no experience required; we’ll train you).
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to think critically.
- Based in or near Irene, Pretoria.

**What you’ll do**

- Learn full-stack development using Java (Spring Boot) and Angular under direct mentorship from senior developers.
- Help design and implement enterprise systems used across South Africa.
- Translate data and business logic into software functionality.
- Work closely with business analysts and engineers on real-world problems.
- Develop the technical foundation to grow into a software engineer, data engineer, or systems architect.

**Why Drive.co.za**

- Be part of the 3rd fastest-growing start-up in South Africa (2025).
- We train analytical minds to become world-class developers.
- Work directly with experienced software engineers and leadership.
- Get exposure to production-grade systems, cloud infrastructure, and data-driven architecture.
- Grow fast in a company that values skill, ambition, and innovation.

###### How to apply

Send your CV, academic transcript, and a short motivation (why you want to move into software development) to [tean@drive.co.za](mailto:tean@drive.co.za)
